Signature.purpose: Spaced-repetition quiz over a question set, with topic and tag filters
Signature.description: Picks the next question by priority — failed first, then unanswered, then already correct, each group shuffled — and skips anything shown within the last hour unless nothing else is left. A question is answered once: the first pick is recorded and further taps ignored. Progress, failure counts, last-shown times and the active filters all persist, so the session survives a reload. The quiz is done only when every filtered question stands at ok.
